items.text: $f\colon P=P(\mathcal M)\to S$; on $P$ the universal invertible quotient $\mathcal M_P=f^*\mathcal M\twoheadrightarrow L=\mathcal O_P(1)$.
For every $S'\to S$ and invertible quotient $\mathcal M_{S'}\twoheadrightarrow L'$ there is a unique $S'\to P$ pulling the universal quotient back to $L'$.
$P$ as a quotient of the vector bundle minus the zero section
V^*(S')=\{\,u\colon\mathcal M_{S'}\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O_{S'}\ \text{epimorphisms}\,\}\subset V(S'),\qquad V^*=V\setminus\text{(zero section)}
V^*\longrightarrow P,\qquad u\mapsto\bigl(\mathcal M_{S'}\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal M_{S'}/\ker u\bigr)
$V^*\to P$ is an epimorphism of sheaves: an invertible quotient $L$ is locally free of rank one, hence locally of the form $u$.
\mathbb G_m(S')=\Gamma(S',\mathcal O_{S'})^{*},\qquad \mathbb G_m=\operatorname{Spec}k[t,t^{-1}]\ \text{(affine case)};\qquad \mathbb G_m\ \text{acts on }V^*\ \text{by }u\mapsto\lambda u
\lambda\ \text{unit}:\ \ker(\lambda u)=\ker u;\qquad \ker u=\ker v\Rightarrow v=\lambda u\qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad P=V^*/\mathbb G_m

\mathbb G_m=\underline{\operatorname{Aut}}(\mathcal O_S);\qquad \{\mathbb G_m\text{-torsors over }S\}\ \simeq\ \{\text{invertible sheaves on }S\},\quad L\mapsto\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_S,L)
The torsor $V^*\to P$ corresponds to the invertible sheaf $\mathcal O_P(1)$.
A morphism $X\to\mathbb P^n$ = an invertible sheaf $L$ on $X$ and sections $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(X,L)$ generating $L$ at every point (equivalently $\mathcal O_X^{n+1}\twoheadrightarrow L$).
